card.name: End of application site before frequency
card.fires_on: The last word of a body-site phrase in dosing directions, such as affected area, conjunctival sac or per nostril. It sits right before a count of times per day.

modes.label: Skin or eye site
modes.description: Final word of the place where a topical product is applied, just before how often.
modes.example: Apply the 0.1% HALOG (Halcinonide Cream, USP) to the affected<< area>> two to three times daily.

modes.label: Per nostril or dose unit
modes.description: End of a per-nostril phrase or a bracketed dose amount, followed by the frequency.
modes.example: nasal solution in adults and adolescent patients 12 years and older with vasomotor rhinitis is two sprays per nostr<<il>> twice daily.

card.writes: It pushes up small count words like two, three and twice, and pushes down words like many and numerous.
card.plain: It fires at the end of where a medicine goes, just before saying how many times a day to use it.
